label: musetalk-r5-3090-dev-20261008
scope: One read-only Vast charges API request through the existing EC2 credential path; no provider inventory refresh, billing mutation, purchase, or account change. Credentials remained in EC2 process memory. No other instance/account charge rows were printed or saved.
actual_billed_status: Not available: existing provider credentials received HTTP 401 from the charges endpoint. This does not mean zero charges and does not establish why the endpoint rejected authentication.
amount_precision_note: The official charges schema describes contract totals rounded to three decimal places, not an exact invoice. No monetary amount or currency was obtained in this request.

cumulative_network_provider_fields.note: These are historical counters, not current usage or charge amounts. Inspected official instance schemas omit these fields; the current official CLI does not define their unit. General per-byte billing and $/GB rate documentation do not establish the raw counter scale.

counter_unit_research.official_rate_unit: inet_down_cost and inet_up_cost are documented as dollars per GB; CLI multiplies listed rates by 1024 for a dollars-per-TB display
